'''Algunnis''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] located within the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==Description==
Algunnis was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] in the [[Algunnis system/Legends|Algunnis system]],<ref name="GK" /> located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] had no [[Planet/Legends|planets]], but boasted a large [[Algunnis asteroid belt|asteroid belt]], which orbited the two suns.<ref name="GK" />

==History==
[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] theorized that when [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was forming, Algunnis traveled past several [[Star/Legends|star]] systems and captured planets. The extreme [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] stresses reduced the planets to rubble, forming a massive [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|field]]. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the belt was devoid of settlements, but was home to [[Exogorth/Legends|space slugs]].<ref name="GK" />
